title: Waves [V11]
description: First version with the finished second verse. According to Fonzworth Bentley, the idea for the second verse came after Fonzworth told Kanye that his brother believes that when the world ends, angels will perpetually come out of waves as they crash down. After being told this, Kanye got Fonzworth and Elon Rutberg (who has a writing credit on release, likely for helping conceptualise the verse) to create an image of this as he is a "visual person". After doing the verse, Kanye changed the album name to Waves, due to what Fonzworth told him and Ye also feeling like the SWISH title "wasnt the best way to communicate what it was that he wanted to communicate". According to Fonzworth, this was also the first time that any spiritual iconography was introduced during SWISH sessions, and is likely what got "Ultralight Beam" added to the album (due to the first tracklist made afterwards having that song on it).
